example.title: Navy Pier restaurant front under the glass arcade (1995 rebuild)
example.place: Navy Pier, Chicago, Cook County, IL

brief: A 1995 pier restaurant: a two-storey front with a big glazed barrel arch over a red-and-blue canopied terrace, lettered 'Navy Pier', tables along the dock edge, boats moored alongside. One photo. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
